test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Illegal mining
P. and groundwater depletion
Q. in protected forests
R. causing habitat collapse
S. eroded biodiversity
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **RSPQ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Illegal mining" and its immediate effect, which is "causing habitat collapse." This is correctly indicated by **part (R).**
 
• The next logical part is "eroded biodiversity" (S), which highlights the impact of habitat collapse.
 
• **The following part**, "in protected forests" (P), provides additional context about the location wher
